sections.h2: North End Virginia Beach Home Prices and Market Pace
sections.html:
In the 24 months from November 15, 2024 to November 14, 2026, 252 residential sales closed in North End Virginia Beach (Virginia Beach, VA) according to REIN MLS records. The median sold price was $1,155,000, well above the citywide median of $405,000, and homes took a median of 23 days to sell, slower than the citywide median of 15 days. These figures come from closed sales, which show what homes actually sold for rather than asking prices.

The middle half of North End Virginia Beach sales closed between $810,750 and $1,677,500, or about $515 per square foot against $240 citywide. Split by year, the median sold price in the most recent 12 months ($1,121,250, 124 sales) was about 8% lower than in the earlier 12 months ($1,225,000, 128 sales). Typical homes sold at about 98.1% of list price (median sale-to-list ratio), which gives buyers some negotiating room.

Recent North End Virginia Beach sales were in ZIP code 23451.

sections.h2: What Stands Out About North End Virginia Beach
sections.html: At a median $515 per square foot, North End Virginia Beach sits 115% above the $240 citywide figure. The median North End Virginia Beach home is about 2,444 square feet, larger than the 1,706 square foot citywide median. 9% of North End Virginia Beach homes sold for more than their list price, versus 36% citywide, so sellers here more often accepted less than the asking price.

sections.h2: When North End Virginia Beach Homes Sell and How Far Prices Range

sections.h2: What Kinds of Homes Sell in North End Virginia Beach
sections.html:
36% of the sales were detached homes and 64% were attached homes (townhomes or condos). The median home was about 2,444 square feet, with the middle half of sales running from roughly 1,868 to 3,000 square feet. 37% of the homes that sold had 3 bedrooms.

Home ages vary widely here: about 80% of sales were built between 1946 and 2022, with a median year built of 1986.
